description: This PHP script acts as a server-side endpoint for executing SQL queries via HTTP requests, specifically interfacing with a MySQL database using the ADODB library. It manages incoming request parameters, executes SQL statements with optional limits and fetch modes, and serializes the result.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Terminates the script execution with an error message.

methods.name: undomq
methods.description: Removes magic quotes from input strings to prevent data corruption.
